The best free online file converters, compared

Online converters handle hundreds of formats, but they run the conversion on their servers and limit free use. Here is what each one gives you for free, from its own pages, and when a converter that runs in your browser is the better pick.

We make File convert, one of the tools on this page. Every fact about the other tools comes from their own pages, linked under each one, as they read on 2026-10-24. Prices and features change: check each site before you choose.

How we compared them

  • Which kinds of files it converts: images, PDF, office, video, audio, data, archives
  • Free limits: conversions a day and file size
  • Where the conversion runs: your device or their servers
  • Whether you need an account
  • Batch conversion

1. File convert (ours)

Best for: Private files and everyday conversions with no daily cap

Converts images, PDFs, video, audio, data, contacts, calendars and archives in the browser, one file or a batch.

Good

  • Nothing is uploaded: every conversion runs on your device
  • PDF to Word, Excel and PowerPoint, merge and split, PDF to images
  • MOV to MP4, video to GIF and WebM, audio to MP3 and WAV
  • CSV, JSON, XLSX, vCard and calendar data; batch convert to a ZIP

Not so good

  • Far fewer formats than CloudConvert or Convertio
  • No Word, Excel or PowerPoint to PDF, and no e-book formats
  • Video is converted on your computer, so long videos take a while on slower machines

Open File convert

2. CloudConvert

Best for: Many formats with high quality, a few times a day

Good

  • Office to PDF, PDF to Word, video, audio, e-books and archives
  • Files are deleted immediately after processing, as its security page says
  • ISO 27001 certified

Not so good

  • Free use is 10 conversion credits a day
  • Files are uploaded to its servers
  • Max processing time of 5 minutes on the free plan

3. Convertio

Best for: The widest choice of formats, including fonts and CAD

Good

  • Over 300 formats, including fonts, CAD and vector files
  • Conversions run in the cloud, not on your computer
  • Output files are bound to your IP address

Not so good

  • Free limits are not spelled out on its pricing page
  • Files are uploaded to its servers
  • Ad-free pages are a paid feature

4. FreeConvert

Best for: Large files up to 1 GB, a handful a day

Good

  • More than 1,500 conversions, with video, audio, documents and e-books
  • Up to 1 GB per file for free
  • Uploaded files are deleted automatically after 8 hours

Not so good

  • Free use is 20 conversion minutes a day

  • Batch of 100 files at a time is a paid-plan feature

Which one to choose

For private files and the everyday jobs (images, PDFs, video to MP4 or GIF, audio to MP3, CSV and XLSX), File convert fits our criteria best: no daily cap, no account, and the file never leaves your device.

When you need a format it does not have, such as Word to PDF, e-books, fonts or CAD, use an online converter. CloudConvert gives 10 free conversions a day and deletes files right after processing; Convertio has the most formats; FreeConvert takes files up to 1 GB on its free plan.

Questions

Is there a file converter that does not upload my files?

Yes. File convert runs every conversion in your browser, so the file stays on your device. CloudConvert, Convertio and FreeConvert upload the file and convert it on their servers.

Which free converter has no daily limit?

File convert has no daily cap, because the work happens on your computer. CloudConvert gives 10 conversion credits a day and FreeConvert 20 conversion minutes a day on their free plans.

Can I convert Word to PDF here?

Not in File convert yet. Open the document in Slop Docs and download it as a PDF, or use an online converter such as CloudConvert, Convertio or FreeConvert.

Can it convert video?

Yes: MOV to MP4, video to WebM or GIF, a frame to a picture, and video or audio to MP3 or WAV. It runs on your device, so long videos take a while on slower computers.
